snippet.textDisplay:
Seeing how the story of this game centers relationship dynamics is so fascinating. Donnie's disregard of women. Jason being narratively compared to Mattia by showing how Mattia is a bad partner and Jason is a good partner. Even a side quest with Alan and Janet. Alan's willingness to grow and his emotional intelligence being communicated through the focus he has on which memories he holds dear, while Janet lives in the moment, but has negative aspects we see in Mattia's personality down to a more grounded level.

My favorite part is Brian's sudden want to retire, because of how Lori was pulled into this. He knew he was too old for this and too in love with her to put her in danger like this.
